result.summary: Found 1 major visual issue: the bottom navigation is obscured by a misplaced black bar. The rest of the visible page appears intact, excluding the intentionally scrollable rows and bottom-cut-off content.

issues.description: A thick black horizontal bar is rendered across the bottom navigation, overlapping and obscuring the middle search and saved/orders icons, making them partially unreadable and hard to tap.
issues.suggestion: Move the system home/gesture indicator into the proper bottom safe-area inset and add bottom padding to the navigation bar so no navigation icons are covered.
